elements.element: The mutual cap equals the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.

Section 10 states that neither party will be liable to the other for indirect damages.
Section 10 states that neither party will be liable to the other for consequential damages, including lost profits or savings.

elements.evidence: The rendered cap is the greater of USD 1,000,000 and 12 months' fees, not an unqualified cap equal to 12 months' fees. It equals 12 months' fees only where those fees are at least USD 1,000,000, which is not demonstrably always the case.

result.reason: The operative redline fully implements the preferred mutual cap, mutual damages exclusion, all required uncapped carve-outs, and payment-obligation treatment. It does not independently satisfy the fallback's exact 12-month-fees cap because of the USD 1,000,000 floor. The changes are targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms, although the surrounding clause numbering and fragmented presentation reduce drafting clarity.
